step.name: Step nodes -- SequenceStep entities: creation, deletion, reposition (x/y), param edits, collapse state and duplication.

dependency.name: Dependency edges -- SequenceEdge entities connecting steps: connect/disconnect.

any.name: Shared sequence substrate -- whole-document schema/snapshot/diff, io codecs, editor and viewer. Owns no mutation; step and dependency are this artifact's only mutation-owning subsets.
